verdict: GitHub Ledger Is Runtime Source Of Truth
details: Runtime governance is loaded from committed, pushed, allowlisted GitHub ledger files. Local files inside a dirty deployed container do not govern behavior unless committed, pushed, allowlisted, and loaded.
docs/ledger/active_rules.json is the compact cross-mode runtime governance entrypoint for rules that must be active now.
The runtime must expose compact internal metadata proving ledger path, version, blob SHA when available, fetch time, rule count, and active verdict names.

When implementation relies on current platform, SDK, SQL, framework, or cloud syntax, cite primary documentation in the delivery note. Prefer official vendor docs over memory or secondary sources, especially for temporally unstable APIs.

verdict: ESPN Payload Grounding Is Mandatory For Game Answers
details: For any game-level sports answer (score, schedule, matchup, series, odds, moneyline, spread, total, line movement, who won, what happened), resolve against ESPN payload first and treat it as authoritative truth before composing output. Required ESPN URL taxonomy: /sports/espn/{sport}/{league}/scoreboard/{date_yyyy_mm_dd}, /sports/espn/{sport}/{league}/events/{event_id}, /sports/espn/{sport}/{league}/events/{event_id}/summary, /sports/espn/{sport}/{league}/events/{event_id}/odds, /sports/espn/{sport}/{league}/events/{event_id}/playbyplay, /sports/espn/{sport}/{league}/teams/{team_id}. Do not answer game facts from screenshots, stale rails, or cached slate-only context when ESPN payload is required. If ESPN grounding fails, return Market lookup unavailable for market/price intents and ESPN grounding unavailable for game fact intents. PASS is only a betting-decision state after real market lookup and never a data-unavailable state.
